description: Free on testnet. Automated scan, not human-verified. Scan-only quick read of whether AI agents can discover and buy from a website. Returns the engine's report as-is: scanner_version and scan_id ("v4"), report.score (scan-only), report.band (can be 'Partly assessed'), report.coverage, report.summary, report.confidence, report.can_agents_buy, report.who_eats_the_loss (display label "Who carries the risk?"; needs the 5 answers, so not assessed here), report.archetype ('unclassified' if not classified), report.rows (with unknown_reason), report.gaps, report.actions (always exactly 3: 2 business then 1 technical, each with kind "business" | "technical"), report.ledger (related Ledger entries), checks, evidence, findings, and scan_interrupted.reason (timeout|blocked|dns_tls|robots_disallowed|refused|http_error) when the scan could not finish. Input: a bare domain (e.g. "yourstore.com"). It reads public pages only; it is NOT a certification, audit or legal advice. Open questions only the business can answer come back with a link to https://thepaymentsnotes.com/readiness. Limits: 3 scans per caller per day and 50 per day overall, shared with the website; results are cached for 24h. Weekly newsletter: https://thepaymentstack.substack.com

domain.description: Bare domain only, e.g. 'yourstore.com' (no https://, path or port)

name: check_agent_readiness
